prompt: Which is the highest waterfall in the world?
response: The highest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls (Salto Ángel in Spanish), located in the Canaima National Park, Bolívar State, Venezuela. Angel Falls drops over a series of cliffs from a height of 979 meters (3,212 feet) and has a clear drop of 807 meters (2,648 feet). It was named after the American aviator Jimmie Angel, who was the first to fly over the falls in 1933.
